instruction: Candid black and white medium full shot of a couple embracing outdoors on an overcast city street. In the center foreground, the man with wavy hair in a dark overcoat (R1) stands with his back to the camera, wrapping his arms around the woman in a black cap and dark coat (R2). The woman stands on the left, facing right, with her hands resting on his lower back as she looks over his shoulder with a soft, neutral expression. The background is softly blurred. The scene is illuminated by diffused, overcast daylight, creating a quiet, intimate atmosphere.
